issues.description: The template defines the measurement function as measure_all_dd, whereas the problem statement, tests, and the solution implementation use the name dd_measure_all. This name mismatch is structural and will confuse students (and break tests) because the intended function (dd_measure_all) is referenced in the specification and solution but absent in the template.
issues.suggestedFix: Rename the function in the template from measure_all_dd to dd_measure_all (and update any internal references) so that the template, problem statement, tests, and solution use the same function name. Alternatively, update the problem statement/tests to reference measure_all_dd consistently.

issues.description: The problem statement and the reference solution expect a measurement function named 'dd_measure_all', but the template repository defines it as 'measure_all_dd'. This inconsistent identifier ordering for the same conceptual operation (measuring all qubits) can confuse students about which function they should implement and where to add their code.
issues.suggestedFix: Rename the template function 'measure_all_dd' to 'dd_measure_all' so its name matches the problem statement and the solution; alternatively, update the problem statement and solution to use 'measure_all_dd' consistently. Prefer aligning the template to 'dd_measure_all' to minimize student confusion.
